title: Original Oven Roasted Thai Chicken Gaeng Curry
description: A classic Thai dish featuring roasted chicken in a tamarind-based curry sauce, this recipe is kid-friendly and egg-free, making it a great option for families
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit
In a large bowl, whisk together tamarind paste, fish sauce, curry powder, salt, and black pepper
Add the chicken to the bowl and toss to coat with the curry mixture
Spread the chicken on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and roast for 25 minutes
While the chicken is roasting, heat the vegetable oil in a large saucepan over medium heat
Add the makham to the saucepan and cook, stirring frequently, until fragrant
Add the coconut milk to the saucepan and bring to a simmer
Once the chicken is done roasting, add it to the saucepan and stir to coat with the curry sauce
Reduce heat to low and let the curry simmer for 10 minutes
Stir in the chopped basil and serve hot over rice
